source_scope_note: Mautic contacts and subscriber rights are not fabricated. The three previously audited first-party consent records were response-only; this does not establish the consent state of all external sources.
production_protection: No original CRM service restart, no customer table mutation, no outbound or payments. The exact HBA rule was added and PostgreSQL reloaded; role and schema privileges were independently checked.
remaining_event_proof: Requires an independently authorised first-party Mautic source and exact genuine Mautic contact-to-canonical-prospect identity, then real signed webhook and authenticated founder browser readback.
